channel.title: Paradise Valley Music Hour
channel.description: Welcome to the Paradise Valley Music Hour, your gateway to the vibrant sounds of the Pacific Northwest and beyond. Join me for an exclusive showcase of the region’s latest talents alongside timeless classics from well-known artists.
channel.itunes:author: Lee Nave
